profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Applied AI • Platform Engineering • Human Centered Products
profile.summary: I turn complex platform capabilities into intuitive, accessible experiences people can trust.  Senior software engineer combining established Windows and web engineering depth with AI directed delivery. Owns requirements, architecture, code review, validation and cross team integration, using agents to implement and investigate changes. Builds platform capabilities and human centered products, with experience in secure execution, shared APIs and device experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied Sciences Group
positions.description:
Applied AI platforms, agent integration and device experiences

• Led agent assisted integration of agent/tool interfaces, live transcription, calendar data and device input for an Android prototype, owning requirements, review and validation for a major demonstration milestone.
• Established an AI assisted workflow translating visual specifications into implementation guidance and visual fidelity checks.
• Directed agent assisted implementation of Android platform components and developed integration designs connecting device capabilities and context with AI experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Windows Platform & AI
positions.description:
Windows APIs, secure execution and assistant integration

• Designed and implemented companion window docking and shared edge resizing, preserving minimum window sizes and coordinated behavior across paired windows.
• Built a shared C++/WinRT projection and registration adopted by at least three teams, avoiding separate wrappers and simplifying assistant API integration.
• Designed and implemented sandboxed script execution and brokered system access for AI assisted diagnostics, working with platform and security partners through technical review.
• Contributed to Recall and Windows Search integration, partnering across platform and experience teams.

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Windows Search and Experiences
positions.description:
• Owned and evolved the Cortana and Windows Search Proactive canvas, bridging system level capabilities with clear, useful, and accessible user experiences.
• Led UX planning, cross team engineering, and delivery for Joint Resize in Windows 11, coordinating Shell, design, and product partners to make multi window workflows feel intuitive.
• Contributed across Windows Shell, window management, cross device interaction, voice, pen, and exploratory interface programs; served as interim engineering manager during Windows update planning.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Bing Experiences
positions.description:
• Shipped user experience improvements across the Bing homepage and account settings.
• Engineered a reusable email experience platform whose content reached 10M+ unique recipients, improving consistency and accessibility across high scale communication templates.

positions.description: Architected and delivered a C#/.NET and TypeScript web platform used by Fortune 500 energy companies for asset management and regulatory compliance tracking.

projects.description: Full stack media and reference application. Combines search, automated tagging/captioning and drawing practice workflows with long running multimodal processing pipelines.

projects.title: Maestra Agent in Atelier Architecture
projects.description: Personal agent orchestration platform. Coordinates tool enabled workflows, persistent state and supervised background execution, with usage accounting and budget controls.
